d:
ATTENTION! CHECK THE TAGS FIRST!

I’ve finally managed to come up with a story that won’t fall apart because of strange ways AI model works.
To be honest, I don’t like the situation with the flood of AI-generated images overwhelming the sad panda one bit, nor am I happy with the results of my attempts at writing prompts. And the results of running those prompts usually look rather mediocre.
Nevertheless, over the course of last three days, I’ve managed to piece together a more or less coherent story from a set of more or less acceptable images.
I can’t understand why simple output dumps from ComfyUI almost always get higher ratings than galleries with even the slightest trace of narrative?
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
The second part has been added, so the gallery is now as it was intended.
It is possible that the gallery will be expanded later.
Sure, sometimes a banana is just a banana. But not always.
